objective: Port netty-codec-memcache (io.netty.handler.codec.memcache and its binary package (memcache binary protocol)) with its original tests: Java names (case and the Async suffix may differ), the original structure and every original comment, and an explicit evidence-backed record for each CLR adaptation and each unit that is not ported.

The switch falls through from READ_HEADER to READ_CONTENT in the source; C# forbids fall-through, so each section ends with goto case to the next state, keeping the order and the per-state try/catch. throw new Error(...) is UnreachableException (as codec-base LengthFieldPrepender). The numbers of the CorruptedFrameException messages use the invariant culture; (totalBodyLength & 0xFFFFFFFFL) keeps the unsigned value. extrasLength() & 0xFF of the System.Byte value equals the Java unsigned conversion, so no sign handling is needed. Sign: the initial capacity MINIMUM_HEADER_SIZE + extrasLength() + keyLength() sign-extends the Java byte, so the System.Byte extrasLength is read as (sbyte), keeping the Java capacity (and its failure for a negative capacity). M is constrained to IBinaryMemcacheMessage.
